title: Warp logo marquee
description: A slim customer strip under a hairline with column ticks: a small muted mono caption ('trusted by …'), then a row of grey wordmarks gliding slowly left (faster while the page scrolls), fading out at both edges of the column.
notes: one set passes every 38s, plus one set over the whole page scroll; with reduced motion the row stands still
